In terms of Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 
read with SEBI Master Circular bearing ref. no. HO/49/14/14(7)2025-CFD-POD2/I/3762/2026 dated 
January 30, 2026 (‘the SEBI Circular’) as amended from time to time, we hereby inform you that Dr. Rajesh 
Gharpure, SMP of the Company has tendered his resignation from the position of Chief Delivery Officer, due 
to personal reasons with effect from the closure of business hours on October 14, 2026 (IST).
There was no material reason for his resignation.
The requisite disclosure is attached as Annexure A. 
The resignation letter submitted by Dr. Rajesh Gharpure is enclosed herewith.
Thanking you,
Yours sincerely,

Subject: Resignation from the position of Chief Delivery Officer of the Company 
 
Hello Sandeep, 
 
I hope this message finds you well.  
 
I would like to tender my resignation from the position of Chief Delivery Officer and SMP of the Company 
due to personal reasons effective from the closure of business hours on Wednesday,  
October 14, 2026 (IST). 
 
I wish to confirm that other than the above-mentioned reason, there is no material reason behind my 
resignation from the above-mentioned position.  
 
I would like to thank the management for the opportunity, and I wish Persistent Systems Limited all the 
success in its future endeavors. 
 
Thanking you, 
Yours Sincerely, 
 
 
 
 
______________ 
Dr. Rajesh Gharpure
